## Description

This PR adds backward compatibility support for the new headers-aware
state stores (TimestampedKeyValueStoreWithHeaders and
TimestampedWindowStoreWithHeaders) when queried through the Interactive
Queries v1 (IQv1) API. Users can now query headers-aware stores using
the existing QueryableStoreTypes API without any code changes.

Reviewers: Matthias J. Sax <matthias@confluent.io>
